label.purpose: Eyebrows, metrics labels, timestamps, footer links — always mono, uppercase.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus transition for buttons and inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled CTA, used once per view for the highest-priority action (e.g. Get in touch).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 100px; background: #B33A15; border: 1px solid #B33A15; color: #FFF8F5; transition: filter .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B33A15; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/tertiary action — anchor-style nav links live in this style.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 100px; background: #FBF8F3; border: 1px solid #E0D8CB; color: #17130F; transition: background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F3EEE5; border-color: #6E6458; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B33A15; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Result/keyword tag inside case studies — mono label type, tinted accent background.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 100px; background: #F6E7E0; color: #B33A15; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Pill-shaped input used in the Ask composer.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Ask about my experience">
components.css: .ds-input { font-size: 0.98rem; color: #17130F; background: #FBF8F3; border: 1px solid #E0D8CB; border-radius: 100px; padding: 13px 22px; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6E6458; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #B33A15; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Signature component: hero status indicator with a live-dot halo, mono uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4A423A; border: 1px solid #E0D8CB; border-radius: 100px; padding: 6px 14px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #B33A15; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #F6E7E0; }

narrative.overview:
This system reads like a well-kept internal memo, not a marketing page: warm paper instead of white, a serif voice for judgment and headlines, a monospace voice for metadata and labels, and a single accent color spent deliberately rather than everywhere. It is a product manager's proof document — evidence-led, hairline-organized, unadorned by cards or shadows — that happens to be beautiful because the person who made it cares about craft.

The palette explicitly rejects the navy/cyan dark-SaaS template look; warm black in dark mode is the deliberate signal of that rejection. Layout is flat and rule-separated rather than boxed, so content density reads as rigor, not clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Newspaper serif display type (Newsreader) paired with a newsroom grotesk body (Schibsted Grotesk) and a mono label voice (JetBrains Mono)
One accent — burnt vermilion — spent sparingly: status dot, links, active/hover states, small chips
Flat, hairline-separated sections; no shadows, no cards
Pill-shaped interactive elements (buttons, chips, inputs) throughout

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Burnt Vermilion never fills a large surface. It marks a single point of attention per view: a status dot, a link, a hover state, a case-study numeral, a chip.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif carries judgment and headlines, sans carries reading, mono carries metadata/labels. Never substitute one register for another.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere in the system. Section and component boundaries are drawn with 1px hairlines or a change from --paper to --paper-alt, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep the accent color rare — one point of attention per view.
Do use hairlines (--rule) and paper/paper-alt tonal shifts for all separation; never a shadow.
Do keep interactive elements fully pill-shaped; keep content containers near-square (4–14px radius).
Do cap running prose at --measure (68ch) and hero/thesis copy at their stated ch-widths.
donts: Don't introduce a navy/cyan dark-SaaS palette — the warm-black dark mode exists specifically to reject that look.
Don't add card backgrounds, box-shadows, or elevation to content sections.
Don't fabricate metrics, testimonials, or case-study content not already in the copy.
Don't use the accent color as a large fill or background.
